metadata.title: Creating a watchOS App
metadata.description: Complete step-by-step guide to creating an Apple Watch app for your Capacitor iOS project with bidirectional communication.

blocks.text: This guide walks you through creating a watchOS companion app from scratch, including project setup in Xcode, integrating the CapgoWatchSDK, and building a functional watch app with SwiftUI.
